visual_review: Inspected final PNG and 512px JPEG. Pepe retains his wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes; both inherited hands each have four fingers and one thumb (five digits). No hands added. No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people or political/hateful symbols observed. Original framing, rock, cracks and lighting retained outside the small pigment addition.
limitations: Local visual inspection is not independent artistic certification.
Inherited rock texture is preserved, including its photographic appearance.
The charcoal bowl is subtle on the darker left rock, especially at thumbnail size.
